title: TrendForce, China's SMEE Reportedly Wins RMB 110M Lithography Tool Contract Amid Domestic Push
notes: Original HTML archived 2026-10-01. Third-party trade-press article (TrendForce), not SMEE's own publication; relays two company-attributed claims used here: (1) SMEE's own May-2025 claim that its 90nm ArF system entered mass production, itself relayed via Commercial Times/21jingji; (2) a Ministry of Science and Technology single-source procurement award (~RMB110m, one SSC800/10 unit, announced 25 Dec 2025), with the KrF/248nm/110nm-resolution/15nm-overlay specification attributed to ICsmart and MyDrivers as TrendForce's own cited sources. Dataset publisher is set to 'smee' for partition-ownership purposes only (the subject firm), not to assert SMEE itself published this article. Source type corrected from company_news to third_party_press_report at integration: the publisher is TrendForce, a market-research firm, not the company. The claim it reports may still originate with the company, which is why an observation drawn from it can be claim_kind company_reported, but the document itself is third-party and a reader following the citation lands on a publication the company does not control.
